notes.text: Configured stylesheets, style elements, CSSOM-inserted style rules, selector lists, specificity, and source-order ties are supported. Static stylesheet and selector behavior is covered by parity fixtures; CSSOM mutation invalidation is covered by package-contract tests.
External and constructable stylesheets, at-rules, sibling combinators, pseudo-elements, and most pseudo-classes are not implemented.
Unsupported CSS is ignored with one actionable warning per distinct declaration by default; strict throw and silent ignore policies remain configurable.
